prompt: A vertical 9:16 shot slightly from above and to the side: the man with the fan from his portrait crouched in the shadowy edge of a studio, the off-set layout from the studio photo around him (light stand, softbox on a boom overhead, cart, coiled cables, a folding chair, a bare concrete floor). Navy pinstripe suit straining at the knees, red-and-gold striped tie hanging forward, gold cufflinks, polished shoes, grey slicked-back hair, ruddy face. He holds a plain white desk fan out at arm's length, its blades a blur, its white power cable trailing away behind him across the floor. His head is tilted up, eyes locked on the camera with a sheepish, guilty half-smile, as if to say nothing is happening, while his hands keep the fan aimed off frame. A wash of bright set light on his face, the background falling to dark grey. Every piece of kit plain and unmarked. His face large and clear. Real photograph.
